name: Zotero
summary: A free, open-source reference manager that collects sources and creates citations.
description: Zotero is a free, open-source reference manager — a personal research assistant that helps you collect, organise, annotate, cite and share research. It can detect sources as you browse the web and save them to your library, and it works inside Word, LibreOffice and Google Docs to insert citations and build a bibliography. The software is free; online storage for synced files includes a free allowance, with paid storage plans for more space.

pricing.free_tier_details: The software is free. File storage includes 300 MB free.
pricing.paid_plan_summary: Extra storage is billed annually: 2 GB, 6 GB or Unlimited. Separate plans exist for labs and institutions.

key_capabilities.text: Collect, organise, annotate, cite and share research.
Detects research as you browse the web so you can save it to your library.
Inserts citations and bibliographies directly inside Word, LibreOffice and Google Docs.

limitations.text: Free file storage is limited to 300 MB; more requires a paid storage plan.
Citations are only as accurate as the saved metadata; always check each reference against the original source.

best_for: Students writing essays, projects or theses with citations
Anyone collecting web and academic sources in one place
not_ideal_for: Storing large collections of PDFs online without paying for extra storage
getting_started: Install Zotero for your computer from the official site.
Follow the official Quick Start Guide to add your first sources.
Install the word-processor plugin and insert your first citation.
